_note: Hand-written annotations for BINDER-CATALOG.md (task T26). 'read' = body of Bind/Fallback was read (FACT-SRC); 'names' = only member names and compiler usage read (UNVERIFIED detail).

PSEnumerableBinder: Convert a value to an IEnumerator following the enumeration rule (CF-PIP-001): AutomationNull = empty; null, string, PSObject-without-base, IDictionary, XmlNode = not enumerable (null result); arrays, DataTable rows, COM enumerables, IEnumerable<T> (typed enumerator preferred), IEnumerable, IEnumerator = enumerated.
foreach, switch, pipelines, @(), operators that accept collections
PSToObjectArrayBinder: Value to object[]: AutomationNull = empty array; non-enumerable = one-element array; List<object> = ToArray; any enumerable = array of its elements.
PSPipeWriterBinder: Write a statement value to the output pipe: AutomationNull writes nothing; non-enumerable written as one object (mutable value types copied via PSVariableAssignmentBinder); enumerable unrolled one level and disposed.
PSArrayAssignmentRHSBinder: Shape the right side of `$a,$b,$c = …` to exactly n elements: list of n = as is; fewer = padded with $null; more = last target receives the rest as a slice; non-list = first target gets it, others $null.
PSToStringBinder: Convert a value to string for expandable strings, -f arguments and file names (ToString via the engine string parser; InvokeToString helper).
expandable strings, format operator, redirection file names
PSPipelineResultToBoolBinder: Captured pipeline list to bool: 0 elements = false; 1 element = that element converted to bool; more than 1 = true.
PSInvokeDynamicMemberBinder: Invoke a method whose name is computed at run time (`$o.$name(args)`).
PSGetDynamicMemberBinder: Get a member whose name is computed at run time (`$o.$name`).
PSSetDynamicMemberBinder: Set a member whose name is computed at run time.
PSSwitchClauseEvalBinder: Evaluate a non-constant switch clause expression against `$_` according to the switch flags (regex, wildcard, exact, case-sensitive, script block).
switch clauses that are not constants
PSAttributeGenerator: Create an attribute instance from positional and named argument values (CreateInstanceBinder); compiled lambda cached per call shape.
PSCustomObjectConverter: Convert an ordered dictionary to a PSCustomObject.
PSDynamicConvertBinder: Conversion whose target type is resolved at run time (type name unresolved at compile time).
PSVariableAssignmentBinder: Copy mutable value types when a value is stored in a variable or written to the pipe (so later mutation does not alias); also notes types with instance members.
assignment to object-typed variables, pipe writes
PSBinaryOperationBinder: Binary operators on arbitrary operands: dispatch on the operation, then rules per operand types (numeric promotion, string/array/hashtable arithmetic, comparison with enumerable filtering, user-defined op_* methods). See OPERATOR-TABLE.md.
PSUnaryOperationBinder: Unary Not, OnesComplement (-bnot), plus, minus, increment, decrement (members Not, BNot, UnaryPlus, UnaryMinus, IncrDecr).
PSConvertBinder: Cast/conversion: AutomationNull converts to the default value of the target; otherwise FigureConversion(value, type) and invoke the converter with invariant culture; binding is restricted by a version number and the language mode; ThrowNoConversion raises the cast error.
PSGetIndexBinder: Index read: dictionaries, arrays (negative indices count from the end, multi-dimensional arrays, slicing by index lists), strings, objects with an indexer, null-conditional; errors via CannotIndexTarget.
PSSetIndexBinder: Index write with the same shapes as read, plus value conversion.
PSGetMemberBinder: Property/field read: instance (ETS) members, adapted .NET members, hashtable/dictionary keys, member enumeration over collections, reserved intrinsic members; strict-mode property-missing errors; language-mode checks.
PSGetMemberBinder.ReservedMemberBinder: Handles intrinsic reserved members of PSObject-style access (nested binder).
PSSetMemberBinder: Property/field write with value conversion to the member type, instance members and adapted members.
PSInvokeMemberBinder: Method call: overload resolution (FindBestMethod with conversion ranks), .Where()/.ForEach() intrinsic methods on collections, method call on each element of a collection, parameterized properties, COM, member-invocation logging.
PSCreateInstanceBinder: Constructor call for `[T]::new(args)` / `New-Object`-style creation; rejects by-ref-like and (optionally) non-public types.
PSInvokeBaseCtorBinder: Call a base-class constructor from a class constructor.
